surfaces.notes: Candidate ci-self-hosted-pr pending independent parent validation.

candidate.title: Pull requests execute attacker-controlled code on shared self-hosted runners
candidate.attacker: fork pull-request contributor whose workflow run is permitted by repository Actions policy
candidate.invariant: Untrusted pull-request code must not inherit internal runner/network authority.
candidate.evidence: ci.yml triggers on pull_request without a trust guard; lint runs-on self-hosted, checks out PR source and invokes local .github/actions/mbx and cargo. mbx/action.yml documents a shared private Docker network/cache. Sibling docs/adoption/roundtrip also use self-hosted PR execution.
candidate.uncertainty: Runner lifecycle, isolation, GitHub approval policy and external fork run enablement need source-backed assessment.

openQuestions: Whether deployed self-hosted runners are disposable and externally isolated is not established by source.
